people.name: Anathoth
people.line: A Levitical city in Benjamin, home of the prophet Jeremiah.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,
